title: Glowing sunflower
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x='47' y='62' width='6' height='32' rx='3' fill='#3ddc45'/>
  <!-- Leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='76' rx='12' ry='6' fill='#59f05e' transform='rotate(-30 36 76)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='84' rx='11' ry='5.5' fill='#2fc136' transform='rotate(25 64 84)'/>
  <!-- Petals - outer ring -->
  <g fill='#ffd93b'>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(30 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(60 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(90 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(120 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(150 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(180 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(210 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(240 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(270 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(300 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='14' transform='rotate(330 50 50)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Petals - inner ring -->
  <g fill='#ffb100'>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='6' ry='10'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(45 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(90 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(135 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(180 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(225 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(270 50 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(315 50 50)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='18' fill='#7a3e10'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='14' fill='#8f4d16'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='10' fill='#a65c1c'/>
  <!-- Seeds -->
  <g fill='#d97b2a'>
    <circle cx='46' cy='46' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='46' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='53' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='53' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='#ffd93b' opacity='0.12'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='32' fill='#ffd93b' opacity='0.1'/>
</svg>
